agent-guide: Print the compact Agon agent guide
ask: Ask one engine a single question
attach: Attach (read-only) to a session: replay its EventLog and follow live (client/server split M2)
call: Live bridge for external CLIs to run Agon modes
campfire: Open discussion — all engines think together, no competition
conquer: Supervised autonomous build in an isolated worktree with an explicit done oracle
council: Roundtable of ALL active engines — each takes a role, the top-rated engine chairs. agon council "<decision>". Agon's stronger LLM-Council: real heterogeneous models, decision brief, directed critique, a chairman verdict with confidence + kill-switch.
daemon: Run a long-lived agon session host (agond) you can attach to (client/server split M3): start | stop | status
doctor: Diagnose Agon engine and worktree health
flow: Agon Flow — node graphs where every AI step is a node. agon flow validate <file> type-checks a flow (subflows, ports, exclusive routes) before a single engine is dispatched.
forge: Run competing implementations in isolated worktrees and select by measured fitness
goal: Run a resumable, dependency-aware, gated goal on an isolated goal/* branch
install-agent-prompts: Install lightweight Agon prompts into another CLI
job: Submit, observe, and cancel daemon-owned autonomous jobs
last: Show the most recent Forge run
login: Log an engine's CLI into its clean workspace-pure config dir so dispatches stay authenticated without inheriting your personal Claude Code setup
mod: Inspect and manage modular Agon packages
mutate: Measure test strength with isolated mechanical or semantic mutants
naturalize: Sanitize, rewrite with a non-author engine, enforce lexical change, and re-scan
nero: Adversarial self-challenge with concrete failure scenarios and a verdict
provenance: AI-contribution / transparency report for a forge run
provider: Add, remove, or list API providers; connect/disconnect and manage API keys
rag: Index and retrieve cited project documentation with local MiniLM embeddings
research: Keyless authoritative research with bounded fetching and independently verified citations
review: Run a non-interactive evidence-grounded review of a Git diff
sanitize: Deterministically detect and remove hidden text and image metadata channels
setup: Plan or apply a durable Modular Agon installation and profile
synthesis: Competitive cross-pollination: draft, swap, improve, and judge
team-brainstorm: Team brainstorm — teams collaborate and compete on a question
team-forge: Two collaborating teams compete using isolated implementation worktrees and measured fitness
team-tribunal: Team tribunal — teams argue opposing positions
think: Sequential thinking — decompose a problem into structured thoughts before acting. agon think "..." --strategy reflexion. Opt-in; surfaces open questions and a goal handoff.
tribunal: Adversarial debate — engines argue different sides of a question
update: Stage, verify, and atomically select a Modular Agon release without overwriting the running process.
upgrade: Stage, verify, and atomically select a Modular Agon release without overwriting the running process.
